definitions.explanation: An administrative division of a city.

examples.japanese: {渋谷区|しぶやく}に{住|す}んでいる。
{新宿区|しんじゅくく}の{役所|やくしょ}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the Shinjuku Ward office.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}には23{区|く}がある。

notes:
〜{区|く} indicates a ward or district.

USAGE:
- Major cities in Japan are divided into wards
- Tokyo has 23 special wards ({特別区|とくべつく})

EXAMPLES:
- {渋谷区|しぶやく}: Shibuya Ward
- {港区|みなとく}: Minato Ward
- {中央区|ちゅうおうく}: Chuo Ward

RELATED:
- {市|し}: city
- {町|ちょう/まち}: town
- {村|そん/むら}: village
